summary: This regulation explains what a listed company must put in its annual report and share with the stock exchange and its own website. It covers financial statements, reports from directors and management, and special environmental and social reports for certain big companies. If any changes happen to the report, the company must also send the revised copy with reasons later.
points: The listed entity must send a copy of the annual report to the stock exchange and publish it on its website on or before the time it is sent to shareholders.
If the annual report changes, the listed entity must send the revised copy along with details and explanations not later than 48 hours after the annual general meeting.
The annual report must include audited financial statements, consolidated financial statements, and a cash flow statement under the indirect method.
The annual report must include a directors report and a management discussion and analysis report.
Top listed entities based on market capitalization must include a Business Responsibility and Sustainability Report.
example: Rohit Fabrics Limited is a company listed on a stock exchange. Before sending its annual report to its shareholders along with the notice of the annual general meeting, Rohit Fabrics Limited must submit a copy of this report to the stock exchange and also publish it on its own website. The report must contain audited financial statements, consolidated financial statements audited by its statutory auditors, a cash flow statement, a directors report, and a management discussion and analysis report. Later, if the company makes any changes to this annual report, it must send the revised copy along with the details and explanations for the changes not later than 48 hours after the annual general meeting takes place.

terms.meaning: A company that has its securities listed on a stock exchange.
A yearly document containing financial statements and business information sent to shareholders.
Financial records that have been officially checked and verified by independent auditors.
The total dollar market value of a company's outstanding shares of stock.

watch: People often confuse when the report must be published on the website, which must happen on or before the commencement of dispatch to shareholders.
